How bubble text works

Outlined circles support upper and lowercase Latin letters and individual digits: 10 becomes a circled 1 followed by a circled 0. Filled circles use uppercase letter shapes for both cases and filled circled digits. Original case cannot be recovered from the filled letters.

Where it helps

Bubble letters are useful for a compact playful label. They take more space than ordinary letters; check narrow mobile profile fields before saving.
